//: The conformance suite is the only test code that imports the application's own adapters — that
is the point of it: the URL builder and the decoder under test are the ones the product ships.
So it cannot live in `tsconfig.node.json`, whose program is the tooling (`vite.config.ts`,
`playwright.config.ts`, the Playwright specs) and deliberately excludes `src`. A project of its
own, carrying both, rather than widening the tooling project to see the whole application.
Not a referenced project of `tsconfig.json`: a reference must emit declarations, and this
one is a pure type check run on its own by `npm run typecheck`.
